test_title: PYST 52: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north. A sits to the immediate left of F. C sits third to the left of E. C is an immediate neighbour of F. D sits to the immediate left of B. How many people sit between B and C?
solution:
**Given:**

Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north.

• A sits to the immediate left of F.

• C sits third to the left of E.

• C is an immediate neighbour of F.

• D sits to the immediate left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81db58ae7aae4b5905275572fe47db2534b1bb6cb9ca3e0887d9d9ae1011b2eb.png] 

Between B and C, only one person (D) sits.

**Hence, the correct answer is "One" (Option 4).**
